affected_subject.reason: Identifies Float128::toPackedFloat normalization logic and isResultL bool.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete condition: inputs with digits >38 but exponent much less than MAXIMUM_EXPONENT causing isResultL false.

direct_effect.reason: Numbers wrongly stored in M_MANTISSA instead of L_MANTISSA, causing significant precision loss.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual relation: valid 38<digits<72 inputs should use L_MANTISSA but actual logic selects M_MANTISSA.

summary: Fragments identify the affected function, triggering input condition, precision-loss effect, and the expected-vs-actual mantissa selection relation.
